title: Manufacturing line qualification bundle
description: Inspection, nonconformance, CAPA, supplier evidence, workflow, and manufacturing ontology sliver.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: manufacturing-line-qualification
  title: Manufacturing line qualification bundle
  description: Inspection, nonconformance, CAPA, supplier evidence, and a manufacturing ontology sliver around line qualification.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-mfg-02
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/manufacturing
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs:
        - part_material.part_number
        - part_material.lot_number
        - quality_inspection.defect_count
        - quality_inspection.overall_disposition
        - nonconformance.nonconformance_description
        - corrective_action.capa_status
        - supplier.supplier_name
      relationshipIds: [supplied_by, inspects, identifies, resolved_by]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/quality_inspection_report, role: review }
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/nonconformance_report, role: exception }
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/corrective_preventive_action, role: completion }
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/supplier_scorecard, role: review }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/manufacturing/bill_of_materials, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/manufacturing/certificate_of_analysis, role: supporting }
  bindings:
    - id: part-to-product-spec
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/quality_inspection_report, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/3/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-mfg-02, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/product_spec }
      ontologyPropertyRef: part_material.part_number
      direction: input
    - id: lot-to-process-flow
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/quality_inspection_report, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/3/fields/1 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-mfg-02, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/process_flow }
      ontologyPropertyRef: part_material.lot_number
      direction: input
    - id: defects-to-capability-gate
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/quality_inspection_report, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/4 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-mfg-02, path: /spec/nodes/6/config/threshold }
      ontologyPropertyRef: quality_inspection.defect_count
      direction: review
    - id: nonconformance-to-rework
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/nonconformance_report, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/1 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-mfg-02, path: /spec/nodes/8/prompt }
      ontologyPropertyRef: nonconformance.nonconformance_description
      direction: exception
    - id: capa-status-to-approval
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/corrective_preventive_action, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/4/fields/1 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-mfg-02, path: /spec/nodes/9/summary }
      ontologyPropertyRef: corrective_action.capa_status
      direction: approval
    - id: supplier-to-intake
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/supplier_scorecard, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/4/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-mfg-02, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/supplier_list }
      ontologyPropertyRef: supplier.supplier_name
      direction: input
